use_cases: Grouping icon buttons with tooltips for dashboard action bars
Creating compact table row action controls with hover descriptions
Building header or toolbar action menus for SaaS interfaces
Implementing user action controls with contextual tooltip guidance
ai_summary: A lightweight action bar component that wraps icon buttons with optional tooltip support. Provides a clean, accessible way to group action controls in dashboards and tool UIs, featuring ghost-style buttons with hover state transitions and screen reader labels for accessibility.
